title: Where languages come from: every language on one map, with its family tree, its future and its homeland
excerpt: 7,674 spoken languages, 421 separate lineages, 52.1% endangered. I mapped every language in Glottolog with its family tree, endangerment, speaker numbers and the proposed homelands of the great language families.
seo_description: An interactive map of every language in Glottolog: language families and isolates, endangerment, speakers and proposed family homelands.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where languages come from' in black and deep teal on cream, beside a world map with a coloured dot for every language: orange across Africa, teal across the Pacific islands, blue from Europe to India, red in China and coral in Australia. Text: every one of the world's 7,674 spoken languages, coloured by family: 238 families and 183 isolates.
